# Outline: Introductory Widget Law (fictional)

## Formation
Sale of goods over the threshold needs a writing signed by the party to be charged. Merchants may confirm by a written note.

## Remedies
Expectation damages put the buyer where performance would have. A buyer who covers recovers the difference between the cover price and the contract price, plus incidental and foreseeable consequential damages.

## Excuse
Impracticability requires an unforeseen event that makes performance far more burdensome, not merely costlier, and a seller who partly can perform must allocate its remaining capacity fairly and tell the buyer.
